dm-describes.text: A DM tells you what you see. The read-aloud box does it here.

dm-secret.text: A DM knows things you do not. The flap holds them until you earn them.

dm-asks.text: A DM asks what you do. Here you type the answer, and it goes on your card.

dm-rolls.text: A DM rolls when the answer is not certain. This is the table they would use.

fate-rule.text: A Fate point buys one thing you want. It is gone once spent. The ticket tears.

gate.text: Planning is free: look, talk, change your mind. Execution is final. Once you break the seal, the dice decide.

lens.text: Old things show at the edge. You read each one as hymn or machine. Neither is wrong.

river-lore.text: The old road crosses the river at a ford. The ferrymen keep the stones and ask a small toll.
